affected_system: urban smoke exposure and clean-air protection system
alternatives: verify protection conditions in the largest apparent gaps
target portable filtration support to confirmed high-risk households
combine building upgrades with accessible public clean-air spaces
assumptions: Air-quality observations carry calibration, siting, and temporal metadata.
Indoor infiltration and filtration effects are measured locally or labeled assumptions.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: Existing filtration and public clean-air resources remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Protection-gap estimates must preserve uncertainty where monitor or building data are sparse.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: air-quality response coordinator and public-health director
decision_question: Which populations experience repeated smoke exposure without reliable indoor clean-air protection?

independence_key.binding_constraint: Protection-gap estimates must preserve uncertainty where monitor or building data are sparse.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Monitor footprints, satellite grids, building records, and population estimates align to declared geographies.

intended_claim: A versioned diagnose design for comparing declared alternatives affecting population smoke-exposure and protection gaps, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in people in high-exposure low-protection conditions
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label modeled particulate exposure as an individual dose or diagnosis.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Monitor footprints, satellite grids, building records, and population estimates align to declared geographies.

title: Diagnose smoke-exposure and clean-air protection gaps
transportability_risks: Smoke chemistry, building leakage, monitor density, and household behavior differ.
Regional forecasts and satellite products may have city-specific resolution limits.
